item.title: dotnet: Announcing .NET 11 Release Candidate 2
item.description:
The .NET 11 Release Candidate 2 release is available. It includes improvements across libraries, runtime, SDK, MSBuild, NuGet, F#, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, and Windows Forms.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: AG-UI Protocol now has a first-class .NET SDK
item.description:
Microsoft released a first-class .NET SDK for the AG-UI protocol. It lets .NET services expose and consume interoperable agent endpoints through Microsoft.Extensions.AI.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: ai: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry: July and August 2026
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry’s July and August 2026 update adds stable Hosted Agent and Toolbox SDK paths, Claude tools support on Azure-hosted deployments, and Model Router updates. It also notes local inference improvements and SDK migration items to review before upgrading.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog
